title: San Antonio floodplain development permit
source_agency: City of San Antonio Development Services Department

permits.name: Flood Plain Development Permit
permits.agency: City of San Antonio Development Services Department

explanations.trigger_explanation: Development within San Antonio's regulatory 100-year FEMA floodplain likely requires a flood plain development permit.

advisories: Restrictions and permit conditions can be added to align the project with floodplain standards.
notes: Tier 2: official city guidance directly states the permit trigger; technical floodplain review remains project-specific.
